name: conxt
description: One memory across your AI tools. Conxt gives this assistant the decisions, preferences, rules and project context you have already built up elsewhere, and saves what you work out here back to the same memory.

interface.longDescription:
Conxt is one memory for all the AI tools you use. It keeps the decisions you have made, your preferences, coding rules, tool choices, workflows, open questions and the people and projects you work with, sorted into those seven types. With Conxt connected, the assistant can look up what you have already decided before it answers, so you stop re-explaining your project in every new chat, and it can save a new decision or finding so the same memory is there in the other tools you connect to Conxt.

For teams, Conxt also reads a team's shared memory. A team memory written from here is only a proposal: it waits in a review queue and has no effect until a person on the team approves it in the Conxt dashboard. The assistant cannot approve team memories.

You stay in control: every memory can be edited, archived or deleted at conxt.dev, the dashboard shows which tool read which memory, and you can disconnect Conxt at any time. Conxt only reads and writes the memory of the account you sign in with, and the teams you belong to.
capabilities: Look up relevant memories before answering
Search decisions, rules and tool choices
Edit or retract your own memories
Propose a team memory for a person to approve
defaultPrompt: What have I already decided about this project?
Remember that we chose Postgres over MongoDB for the API.
What questions are still open on my project?

positive.description: Answer from an existing decision instead of asking the user to re-explain
positive.prompt: What did we decide about rider payments for Pedalway?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_context and answers that the decision is to use Stripe for rider payments, because checkout handles card storage and tax so the team never holds card numbers. Does not invent other decisions.

positive.description: List the coding rules on record
positive.prompt: What coding rules do I follow on Pedalway?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_decisions and lists the rules on record, including storing all money as integer cents, never floats, and naming tests as sentences.

positive.description: Save a new decision to memory
positive.prompt: Remember that we decided to launch the Pedalway downtown pilot on 3 November.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls add_memory with a decision about the 3 November downtown pilot launch and confirms it was saved. The new memory then appears in the test account's Memory list at conxt.dev/dashboard, attributed to the connected app.

positive.prompt: What questions are still open on Pedalway?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_memories filtered to open questions and lists them, including whether to charge members an unlock fee. Presents them as undecided, not as decisions.

positive.prompt: What does my Pedalway team have on record about deploys?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_my_teams to find the Pedalway team, then get_team_memories, and answers that production deploys happen on Tuesdays only and that deploys go to staging first. Only approved team memories are used.

negative.description: Approving team memory is reserved for a person in the Conxt dashboard
negative.prompt: Approve every pending memory in my Pedalway team.

negative.description: Running a team's governed actions needs a team API key, not a personal sign-in
negative.prompt: Run the refund playbook for order 1042 on my Pedalway team.

negative.description: Reading a team the user does not belong to
negative.prompt: Show me everything the Acme Logistics team has saved in Conxt.

review.commerce_description: Conxt does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Every tool now sets all four annotation hints explicitly to true or false. Request an action (propose_action) is marked destructive and open-world: once approved it runs an action in the team's external system that cannot be undone.
